boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten recurring traditions that CSUB officially identifies as traditional or signature campus programs, from Rowdy Run to freshmen receiving midterm encouragement letters.

cards.title: Run With Rowdy
cards.subtitle: A signature CSUB campus tradition centered on the Roadrunner mascot
cards.notes: Watch Campus Programming’s announcements for the next Rowdy Run, then confirm the route, eligibility rules, and check-in details before joining.
cards.short_summary: A mascot-centered run that turns CSUB’s Roadrunner identity into a recurring campus activity.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB Campus Programming identifies Rowdy Run as both a signature program and one of its traditional events.
cards.access_notes: Dates, route, eligibility, and registration requirements vary; consult the current Campus Programming announcement before attending.

cards.title: A Letter Arrives at Midterms
cards.subtitle: Freshmen receive encouragement from the wider Runner community
cards.notes: If you are invited to contribute, write a specific, supportive note for a new student and follow the submission instructions from Campus Programming.
cards.short_summary: CSUB rallies faculty, staff, students, alumni, and families to encourage freshmen during midterms.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB describes Runner Letter Day as a day-long event where every freshman receives an encouraging letter from faculty, staff, student leaders, alumni, family, or friends.
cards.access_notes: Participation and letter-submission instructions are event-specific; use the current Campus Programming announcement.

cards.title: One Name, Two Big Formats
cards.subtitle: CSUB’s student-only tradition alternates between carnival and concert formats
cards.notes: Check the current Runner Nights flyer for its format, student-verification requirements, permitted items, and any advance RSVP instructions.
cards.short_summary: An annual CSUB-only student gathering staged as either a carnival or a concert.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB’s 2025–26 recruitment booklet calls Runner Nights an annual, CSUB-student-only event hosted as either a carnival or concert.
cards.access_notes: Official materials describe this as CSUB-student-only; verify the current flyer for admission and identification requirements.

cards.title: Home Is a Whole Week
cards.subtitle: Runner pride unfolds through a sequence of student and alumni events
cards.notes: Open the current Homecoming schedule and choose an age-appropriate campus activity; verify whether registration, tickets, or CSUB identification apply.
cards.short_summary: CSUB stretches homecoming across multiple activities that reconnect students and alumni.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB identifies Homecoming as a signature traditional program and says Homecoming Week features multiple activities for students and alumni.
cards.access_notes: Individual Homecoming activities have separate audiences, registration rules, and costs; consult the current official schedule.

cards.title: Start the Semester Runner-Style
cards.subtitle: A recurring welcome tradition listed by CSUB Campus Programming
cards.notes: Use the current Week of Welcome calendar to select activities that fit your schedule, then confirm location and student-access requirements.
cards.short_summary: CSUB marks the opening of the academic year with a named sequence of welcome activities.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB Campus Programming lists Week of Welcome among the university’s traditional events.
cards.access_notes: Programming changes by term; confirm each activity’s location, audience, and attendance requirements on the current flyer.

cards.entity_name: CSUB New Students and Family Weekend
cards.title: Bring the Family Into Runner Life
cards.subtitle: A CSUB traditional event designed around new students and their supporters
cards.notes: Review the current family-weekend schedule together, register where required, and confirm which sessions welcome guests before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A recurring CSUB weekend connects new students’ campus transition with their families.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB Campus Programming lists New Students and Family Weekend among its traditional events.
cards.access_notes: Dates, guest eligibility, registration, and activity costs are not established on the overview page; verify the current schedule.

cards.title: Take the Mic in Your Own Medium
cards.subtitle: Songs, poetry, verse, and other art forms share one CSUB stage
cards.notes: Prepare a campus-appropriate piece in your chosen medium, then check the current event notice for performer sign-up and audience access.
cards.short_summary: A recurring creative outlet where CSUB students can present work in multiple forms.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB says Expression Nights give students an outlet to express their talents through song, verse, poetry, or another art form of their choice.
cards.access_notes: Performance sign-up, venue, audience eligibility, and content guidance are event-specific; consult the current notice.

cards.title: A Campus Conversation in a Brown Bag
cards.subtitle: CSUB treats its recurring discussion series as a signature tradition
cards.notes: Read the announced topic before attending, bring thoughtful questions, and confirm whether the session is limited to the campus community.
cards.short_summary: A named CSUB discussion series makes conversation itself part of recurring campus programming.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB Campus Programming identifies Brown Bag Discussions as a signature program and lists it among traditional events.
cards.access_notes: Topics, speakers, venues, and attendance rules vary by session; check the current Campus Programming announcement.

cards.title: A Week With the World on Campus
cards.subtitle: International learning appears on CSUB’s official roster of traditional events
cards.notes: Scan the current week’s program for a talk, performance, or activity, then verify its venue, audience, and registration requirements.
cards.short_summary: CSUB’s recurring international-education program gathers globally focused activities under one week.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB Campus Programming lists International Education Week among the university’s traditional events.
cards.access_notes: The overview does not establish a current schedule; verify individual programs and attendance requirements before visiting.

cards.title: A Month on CSUB’s Tradition Calendar
cards.subtitle: Recurring heritage programming recognized by Campus Programming
cards.notes: Choose an event from the current CSUB calendar, read its purpose and participation guidance, and confirm the location before attending.
cards.short_summary: CSUB recognizes Latinx Heritage Month as part of its recurring traditional campus programming.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB Campus Programming lists Latinx Heritage Month among its traditional events.
cards.access_notes: Programs and access conditions vary across the month; consult the current official calendar for event-level details.
